description: This file defines a PHP trait named VueComponentPermissionTrait used to manage permissions within a Vue.js component in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for setting permissions based on data groups, utilizes other traits and classes, and enforces that it should only be used within classes extending AbstractVueController.

methods.name: setPermissions
methods.description: Sets user role permissions for data groups by retrieving the permission collection and updating the Vue context with permissions. Throws a LogicException if used outside of a class extending AbstractVueController.
